source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that approved Network Stack Configuration values persist across save/reboot and return to SPEC defaults after Load Default while intended NIC, network-boot and management paths remain healthy.
original_method: Change Network Stack fields in BIOS, save/reboot and verify persistence; then Load Default, save/reboot and compare with SPEC, collecting firmware, NIC/network-boot, management and log evidence.
manual_activity: A human must navigate the firmware Network Stack page, perform both save/reboot/default phases and visually verify the values. Automated reachability, DHCP/PXE or NIC evidence is supporting evidence and does not automate the core acceptance.
required_inputs: Named Network Stack fields with baseline, non-default and SPEC-default values
Approved DHCP/PXE/network target and isolated test context if exercised
Console/operator, stable power and alternate BMC/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or guess a PXE/DHCP target.
Maintain an independent management path before changing network boot or firmware NIC controls.
Use only approved isolated network-boot infrastructure and do not boot untrusted media.
Stop on wrong target, unexpected boot selection, NIC/management loss, hang or crash.
Restore the approved final network state.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only NIC, boot-entry, DHCP/PXE transcript, reachability, OS and BMC health evidence when approved.
Compare firmware captures and network behavior against the field/target matrix.
Do not drive BIOS, select an unapproved network target, change production DHCP/PXE infrastructure or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Define/approve the firmware field/default matrix, network targets and alternate recovery.
Perform/capture non-default persistence and default-restoration phases.
Evaluate firmware and network-boot/management evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects BIOS execution by the agent. No source command exists; network probes and PXE transcripts can support evidence but cannot replace the firmware page or visual persistence/default checks.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the manual BIOS sequence and use approved read-only NIC/boot/reachability and isolated DHCP/PXE evidence; do not substitute OS network configuration changes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source two-phase sequence, no-script state and 5/20-minute fields are preserved; all/random remains source text but is bounded for execution.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each approved BIOS field to NIC/port/protocol/boot entry and expected network target; capture firmware values plus isolated network-boot and alternate-management evidence at baseline, persistence, default restoration and final state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS Network Stack implementation, NIC firmware and approved network-boot environment.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, NIC firmware, DHCP/PXE service, OS and capture-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform Network Stack/PXE specification and project boot-infrastructure definition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target identity and path-specific evidence while retaining both firmware transitions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; reachability alone is not treated as firmware Network Stack coverage, and PXE boot is included only when approved.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field/default mapping, target infrastructure and alternate recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Network service responses may come from the wrong VLAN/server; transcripts must identify the interface and approved target.

project_override_considerations: The project may select IPv4/IPv6/PXE/HTTP or other platform-supported fields and decide whether an actual network boot is in scope. Results apply only to named paths and must not claim all protocol coverage.
expected_evidence: Identity, approval, NIC/boot/target baseline and alternate recovery
First save/reboot persistence plus NIC/network-boot/management evidence
Load Default, second save/reboot, SPEC comparison and boot-path health
Final network/management state, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require persistence and SPEC-default restoration. Missing field and network-target details are readiness inputs, not contradictory source facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The firmware Network Stack intent is clear. Project targets, infrastructure and defaults gate execution but do not permanently block the library case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with its manual BIOS boundary and adds network-path evidence and recovery.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its NIC/PXE/alternate-management improvements but rejects PARTIAL classification based only on automatable supporting evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Restores MANUAL ONLY under the locked rule because human firmware interaction/observation is the core acceptance, while preserving agent evidence scope.

review_improvement: Prevents useful network evidence from being mistaken for automated firmware acceptance and binds any network boot to an approved interface and target.
independent_technical_reasoning: Both decisive state transitions and observations occur in BIOS and must be performed by a human. Agent-collected NIC or PXE evidence is post-action support, so V3.1 requires MANUAL ONLY rather than PARTIAL.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat firmware changes, network boot or default load after a wrong target, management loss or ambiguous result; preserve transcripts and obtain engineer disposition.
